gbm_population_evidence.quote: Known or radiologically suspected primary or secondary brain tumor (suspected metastasis, meningioma, glioma, etc.) with surrounding edema causing clinical signs

candidate_evidence.quote: [DIETARY_SUPPLEMENT] Salovum/SPC flakes: Egg yolk powder and specially processed cereals
Since Salovum® is not classified as a drug, clinical trials have only required ethics approval.
is classified as a "food for special medical purposes" by the European Food Safety Agency

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Both patients with steroid naïve edema (in newly diagnosed participants) and steroid refractory edema (participants on steroid medication but with severe side effects or insuffiscient effect) will be recruited.

role_evidence.quote: [DIETARY_SUPPLEMENT] Salovum/SPC flakes: Egg yolk powder and specially processed cereals

The objective of this clinical trial is to explore the effects of Salovum®, an egg yolk powder enriched with the endogenous protein antisecretory factor, and SPC® flakes , hydrothermically processed oats, on cerebral edema with clinical symptoms in participants with brain tumors.

agents.drug_class_hint: Salovum: egg yolk powder (B221) enriched in antisecretory factor; food for special medical purposes / dietary supplement, not a licensed medicine; used for tumour-induced cerebral oedema

role_evidence.quote: Ingest SPC® flakes 1g/kg daily from day 7

agents.drug_class_hint: SPC flakes: hydrothermically processed oats inducing antisecretory factor; dietary product, not a licensed medicine

coder_notes: Single registered dietary-supplement intervention combining two products (Salovum egg yolk powder and SPC oat flakes); listed as two rows. Both are food/supplement products explicitly 'not classified as a drug', so excluded intervention type; purpose is symptom control of tumour-induced cerebral oedema (no antitumour outcome), so it would be supportive in any case. Population: brain tumours of any kind with oedema (metastases, meningioma, glioma); glioblastoma named in conditions, coded basket_gbm_eligible (could alternatively be read as mixed; both include). Treatment setting not defined in relation to tumour therapy (steroid-naive newly diagnosed and steroid-refractory patients), coded unclear. Corticosteroids are background care, not registered interventions, not listed.
